pages.text: A second set of bound curios. Like the first, these sleep unless the bearer is Branded. Most of them work with the Oath's own curses instead of against them.
$(l)Blood Toll$() drains hunger instead of health. If you are already starving, the toll takes blood again. A charm for bearers who fight often and eat well.
When a hit leaves you below $(l)40% health$(), the Knell tolls. Monsters within $(l)6 blocks$() are knocked back and get $(l)Weakness I$() and $(l)Slowness I$() for 5s. Cooldown: $(l)30 seconds$().
Melee hits restore $(l)10% of the damage dealt$() as health, up to 1.5 hearts per hit. Each draught adds a little hunger, so it pairs poorly with an empty stomach.
Take $(l)6% less damage$() for each harmful effect on you, up to $(l)30%$(). The Oath, the Severance, and your enemies all supply the afflictions.
